title: EEG: Continuous gameplay of an 8-bit style video game
description: This dataset contains EEG recordings from 17 participants collected during continuous gameplay of an 8-bit style video game (Escape from Asteroid Axon), along with two additional tasks: a 2-stimulus visual oddball task and a 2-doors gambling task. The tasks were implemented in Java and generated both EEG event triggers and continuous behavioral log data (movement, player position, actions, antagonist position, loot box events, etc.). Data were collected circa 2015 in the Cognitive Rhythms and Computation Lab at the University of New Mexico.
methods_description: EEG was recorded during three tasks implemented in Java: a video game (Escape from Asteroid Axon), a 2-stimulus visual oddball task, and a 2-doors gambling task. Each task sent triggers to the EEG recording system and also output continuous behavioral data to a .csv log file capturing movement, player position, actions, and game state information.
